webhook.hmacHint: Callers sign the body with HMAC SHA-256 and send it as X-Hub-Signature-256, like GitHub.
webhook.shownOnce: Shown once. Copy it now, it cannot be read back.
webhook.rotateHint: The old URL stops working immediately.

templates.description: Ten tested starters. Pick one, name it, and edit it afterwards.
templates.name: Pipeline name

code.transient_network: Network or registry hiccup. Rerun, or add retries so it heals itself.
code.out_of_memory: The job ran out of memory. Raise its memory limit.
code.step_timeout: The job hit its time limit. Raise the timeout.
code.disk_full: The node is out of disk. Free space on the node, then rerun.
code.missing_secret: A credential is missing or wrong. Set the secret the step reads.
code.image_not_found: The job image does not exist or is private. Fix the image name or tag.
code.command_not_found: A tool is missing from the job image. Pick an image that ships it.
code.node_peer_deps: Peer dependency conflict. Fix the versions, or install with --legacy-peer-deps.
code.node_module_missing: A dependency is not installed. Run the install step before this one.
code.python_module_missing: A Python package is not installed. Add it to requirements.txt and install first.
code.go_version: The Go image is older than go.mod asks for. Use a newer golang image.
code.permission_denied: A step cannot read or write a path. Check file modes and the working directory.

insights.title: Reliability and timing
insights.diffTitle: Latest run against the last fully passing run
